caption: the living house tie-in - three kids, a possessed basement and better mechanics than the tie-in tax.
about: Monster house (2006) turns the movie's premise into a three-character action adventure: dj, chowder and jenny infiltrate the possessed house in rotating stages, each kid with a different tool - water balloons, kite, digger - against the living floorboards. The level design respects the film's blueprints, which makes it one of thq's better tie-ins.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
